_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

title.description: Title of the engineering change; used as its display value in other collections

customerName.description: Display value of customerId, copied from u_mes_mast_customer.name

raisedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'raised'

raisedBy.description: Display name of the user in raisedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

raisedAt.description: Date and time when the record was raised. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

effectiveFrom.description: Effective from. Date field: calendar date only, stored as 00:00:00 of that day in local plant time (IST) with the +0000 suffix

stockDispositionTypeId.description: Reference to u_mes_qual_dispositionType._id: stock disposition type

stockDispositionTypeName.description: Display value of stockDispositionTypeId, copied from u_mes_qual_dispositionType.name

implementedAt.description: Date and time when the record was implemented. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

closedAt.description: Date and time when the record was closed. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

gmpImpact.description: True when the change affects GMP-relevant product, process, equipment or systems (GMP-44)

validationRequired.description: True when process, equipment or system validation is required

regulatoryImpact.description: Regulatory or customer approval needed before implementation

riskAssessmentName.description: Display value of riskAssessmentId, copied from u_mes_qual_riskAssessment.title

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
